title: Shocked to see use of heavy equipment at Sheshnag, no need for motorable roads to pilgrimages: Dr. Karan Singh
description: ‘I was shocked to read that heavy earth moving equipment is being used to widen the route to Shri Amarnath ji, and that too at a spot overlooking Sheshnag, which is one of the most beautiful lakes in India,’ said Dr. Karan Singh
